summary:
**EarthPulse – Understanding Earth's Climate Through NASA Data**

EarthPulse is an interactive web application developed using Python and Streamlit to explore Earth's climate patterns using NASA POWER satellite data. Users can select different geographical locations and view climate information, including temperature and rainfall patterns, through interactive graphs and statistical summaries.

The application retrieves climate data from NASA's POWER API and presents it in an easy-to-understand dashboard. It also provides options to explore different time periods and download climate records in CSV format.

EarthPulse addresses the challenge by making NASA's scientific climate data more accessible and understandable to everyone. It helps users explore geographical climate variations, identify temperature and rainfall trends, and develop awareness of environmental changes.

This project is important because understanding climate patterns is essential for environmental awareness, informed decision-making, and building a sustainable future. EarthPulse aims to connect satellite-based scientific data with everyday users through a simple and interactive platform.
details:
Project Details – EarthPulse

EarthPulse is an interactive climate exploration platform developed to make NASA satellite-based climate data accessible and understandable to everyone.

How does it work?

Users can select a geographical location and a time period through the application. EarthPulse retrieves temperature and rainfall information from the NASA POWER API and displays it through an interactive dashboard. Users can explore climate statistics, visualize temperature and rainfall patterns using graphs, and download the collected data in CSV format.

Benefits

  • Makes NASA climate data easier to access and understand.
  • Helps users explore temperature and rainfall variations across locations.
  • Provides interactive graphs and statistical summaries.
  • Supports climate awareness and environmental education.
  • Allows users to download data for further analysis.

Intended Impact

The main aim is to increase awareness of Earth's changing climate by connecting scientific satellite data with everyday users. The project encourages people to explore environmental patterns and understand the importance of climate monitoring for a sustainable future.

Tools and Technologies

  • Programming Language: Python
  • Frontend and Application Framework: Streamlit
  • Data Processing: Pandas
  • Data Visualization: Plotly
  • API Integration: NASA POWER API
  • Location Search: Open-Meteo Geocoding API
  • Development Environment: Visual Studio Code
  • Version Control: Git and GitHub

Creativity and Innovation

EarthPulse combines NASA's scientific data with an easy-to-use and visually appealing interface. Instead of presenting complex scientific datasets, it transforms climate information into interactive charts, summaries, and location-based exploration. Its location selection and data download features make climate exploration simple and engaging.

Factors Considered by the Team

Our team considered data accessibility, ease of use, accuracy of information, response time, geographical coverage, and the reliability of external APIs. We also considered the importance of presenting scientific information in a simple format that users without technical knowledge can understand.

EarthPulse aims to make climate information more accessible and encourage environmental awareness through technology.
